questions.text: Does the screen show an image?
Can you hear the computer starting normally?
Does the computer become very hot?
Does the computer shut down unexpectedly?
Can the computer connect to Wi-Fi?

recommendations.title: Check the power connection
recommendations.description: The computer may not be receiving power. Check the socket, cable and power adapter.

recommendations.title: Possible power supply problem
recommendations.description: Power is reaching part of the computer, but the system is not starting normally.

recommendations.title: Possible display problem
recommendations.description: The computer appears to start, but no image is displayed. Check the monitor, cable or display connection.

recommendations.title: Possible overheating problem
recommendations.description: The computer may be shutting down to protect itself from excessive heat. Check airflow and cooling.

recommendations.title: Possible network problem
recommendations.description: The computer is running but cannot connect to Wi-Fi. Check the network connection and Wi-Fi settings.
